decisionsTitle: «Tombolă», a folded section of the editor's race numbers, and why the volunteers are out of the raffle said where it is seen (amending how §949 and §984 drew the raffle's settings)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20, from a phone, looking at the editor's raffle settings:** «vreau să le dau automat numere și voluntarilor, pentru că văd că deși voluntarii sunt bifați aici… cumva sunt excluși de pe lista de la tombolă» (I want to give the volunteers numbers automatically too, because although the volunteers are ticked here, somehow they are left out of the raffle's list) — «plus că aici ar trebui să fie o secțiune colapsată cu „Tombola”» (and here there should be a collapsed section, «Tombola»).

**What was there.** §949 put «Avem tombolă» in the editor's «Numere de concurs (BIB)», because a raffle is drawn on the race numbers, and §984 added under it «Cine poate participa la tombolă», «Cum participă» and «Înscrierile la tombolă sunt deschise» — a dozen open lines in the card, between the first number's box and the bib designer. §984's one answer takes a volunteer only confirmed and with a number (`noNumber` otherwise), and a volunteer's number is the volunteers' own series (§948): «Numerele voluntarilor încep de la» in the «Voluntari» card, which numbers every confirmed volunteer at once and each later one at their confirmation. The race had no series, so the volunteers ticked in the editor read «Nu · fără număr» on the «Tombolă» tab, and nothing said why or what to do.

**Decision.**

- **«Tombolă», one fold.** Everything about the raffle in the editor — «Avem tombolă» and, under it while it is ticked, «Cine poate participa la tombolă» with its three ticks, «Cum participă», «Înscrierile la tombolă sunt deschise» and their help — is one level-4 fold, `#box-raffle`, of «Numere de concurs (BIB)», where §949 put it, its glyph the wrapped prize. Closed on arrival, the editor's rule for an option a race may skip; its bar says «nu avem» / “none” without a raffle, else who takes part and how — «Alergători, elite, voluntari · din oficiu», «Alergători · cu înscriere separată», «Nicio grupă bifată · din oficiu» — from the saved event (`box-summaries.ts#raffleSummary`). It opens by itself right after the save that moved one of its boxes: the save says so (`saveEventAndTranslations` → `raffleChanged`, `domain/raffle.ts#raffleSettingsMoved`), the action adds `raffle=1` to the redirect beside `saved=event`, and the editor opens the card, the race numbers and «Tombolă» (`openWhen.saved`), as the race numbers' card opens after a press in the elite card (§895); `raffle=1` beside any other banner opens nothing. A box a refusal names opens the folds around it, as every fold's does (`ActionForm`'s `revealField`; with scripts off, `BOXED_DISCLOSURE_SX`). The boxes, their names, their markers and the one editor save are §984's, unchanged. «Schimbă în editor» on the tab now lands on the fold itself (`#box-raffle`), and the tab's sentence for an event without a raffle names it («„Numere de concurs” → „Tombolă”»).
- **Why the volunteers are out, said where it is seen.** While the raffle counts the volunteers and some confirmed volunteers wear no number, one line says how many and how — «{count} voluntari confirmați nu au număr, deci nu intră la tombolă. Setează „Numerele voluntarilor încep de la” în cardul «Voluntari»: fiecare confirmat primește pe loc un număr.», in `countForm`'s three forms and in English, at most 200 characters — an outlined warning with «Mergi la numerele voluntarilor», a 44-pixel link to the «Voluntari» card's numbers form, which gains the anchor `#box-volunteer-numbers` (`OpenFoldFromHash` opens the card around it). In two places: under the editor's «Voluntarii» tick, counted from the «Voluntari» card's own read (`confirmedVolunteersWithoutNumber`, no query of its own) and following that tick as it is unticked and ticked again (`OnlyWhenTicked`: hidden, never removed); and on «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» right under the counts, beside «Voluntari: N», counted from the roster's own `noNumber` volunteers (`leftOutForNoNumber`) — none while «Voluntarii» is unticked —, for whoever manages the volunteers (`canManageVolunteers`, who sets the series), and never on paper. A volunteer registered and not yet confirmed, or cancelled, is not counted. Gone once every confirmed volunteer has a number.
- **Nothing else.** No number is ever chosen by itself: the series' start is the club's, and it must clear the runners' numbers (`VOLUNTEER_NUMBERS_IN_RACE_SERIES`); the line only says where. The raffle's rules (`raffleParticipation`), its lists, its files, its doors and the draw are §984's, unchanged.

**Refused.**

- *Numbering the volunteers by itself — a default start, say past the runners' last number.* The owner's «automat» is what the series already does once its start is set: every confirmed volunteer gets a number at once, every later one at their confirmation. The start is the club's to choose: it must clear the runners' numbers and the desk's spares, and a number printed on a badge or a bib cannot quietly move. The line says where to set it.
- *Taking the volunteers without a number into the raffle.* The draw is made from the file's numbers (§948, §984); a volunteer without one could not be called from it.
- *Opening «Tombolă» after every save of the editor.* A fold that opens for a save that changed nothing in it opens for no reason (§336); the save says when it moved the raffle.
- *Opening the fold by itself while volunteers lack numbers.* The line sits under the tick, inside the fold, and on the tab where the raffle is worked; a fold that opened for a reminder would open on every visit until race day.

**Who.** The fold is the Administrator's, as the editor's save is (§542); the line on the tab is for the Organizer and the Administrators, who set the volunteers' series. Nothing public changes.

**Proof.** `tests/unit/content/raffle-fold-render.test.ts` (the fold, its bar in both languages, its names, open after its save and around a refused box, the line under «Voluntarii»), `tests/unit/volunteers/raffle-number-hint.test.ts` (who is counted, which save opens the fold, the line and the card's anchor), `tests/integration/volunteers/raffle-volunteers-without-number.test.ts` (the tab, the editor page's count and flag, the save's `raffle=1`, the line gone after «Salvează numerele»), `tests/e2e/raffle-fold-and-volunteer-numbers.spec.ts` (at 320 pixels and on a desktop).
changelogLine: - **«Tombolă», a fold of the editor's race numbers, and why the volunteers are out of the raffle** — everything about the raffle in one closed section whose bar says who takes part and how, open again right after its save; under «Voluntarii» and on «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă», «N voluntari confirmați nu au număr…» with a link to «Numerele voluntarilor încep de la», gone once they have their numbers. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event's editor, then «Avem tombolă», «Cine poate participa la tombolă» with «Alergătorii», «Elitele» and «Voluntarii», «Cum participă» and «Înscrierile la tombolă sunt deschise» stand inside one fold «Tombolă» / “Raffle” (`#box-raffle`, a level-4 fold of «Numere de concurs (BIB)»), closed on arrival, posting the same names and markers to the same save; its closed line says «nu avem» / “none” without a raffle, else the groups ticked and how — «Alergători, elite, voluntari · din oficiu» / “Runners, elites, volunteers · automatically”; and it opens by itself, with «Numere de concurs (BIB)» and «Participare, înscrieri și regulament», on the page a save that moved one of the raffle's settings returns to (`?saved=event&raffle=1`, the save's own answer) — never after a save that moved none — and around a box a refusal names (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event whose raffle counts the volunteers («Voluntarii» ticked) and has confirmed volunteers without a number, then one line under the editor's «Voluntarii» and on «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» under its counts says how many — «{count} voluntari confirmați nu au număr, deci nu intră la tombolă. Setează „Numerele voluntarilor încep de la” în cardul «Voluntari»: fiecare confirmat primește pe loc un număr.», in the three Romanian forms and in English, at most 200 characters — with a 44-pixel link to the «Voluntari» card's numbers form (`#box-volunteer-numbers` on the event's editor); a volunteer not yet confirmed or cancelled is not counted; the line is absent once every confirmed volunteer has a number or while «Voluntarii» is unticked (on the editor hidden with the box, following it as it is ticked), is counted from what each page already reads, and gives nobody a number — after «Salvează numerele» numbered them it is gone and they take part (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Tombolă» folded in the editor, and why the volunteers are out of the raffle
